newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion says FDA clears Fareston in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Orion says FDA clears Fareston in U.S.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) had given it marketing clearance in the United States for its Fareston breast cancer drug.

"Fareston is the first new anti-estrogen treatment for breast cancer to become available in the United States in 20 years", the company said in a statement, adding that it was also the first Finnish human drug to win FDA approval.
Fareston was to be used in first-line therapy for post-menopausal women with metastatic breast cancer, Orion said.
It said more than 180,000 new cases of female breast cancer were expected to be diagnosed in the United States this year.
Schering-Plough will market Fareston in the United States, Orion said.
